display_title: The Circumstances Between the Duke and His Maid
description:
Ji Yeojin was a B-list, sometimes C-list actress ever since she was a child!  
She possessed one of the characters from her unfinished novel that she wrote while waiting around the filming set!  
Before she knew it, 8 years had passed since she came to this world… and lots of extremely absurd things keep happening…
